description: This Java source file defines the ContactAdder activity for an Android application, responsible for creating new contacts by collecting user input (name, phone, email) and saving it to the device's contacts database. It manages account selection, handles UI interactions, and performs batch content provider operations to insert contact data.

classes.name: ContactAdder
classes.description: Main activity class for adding new contacts, implementing account selection, handling UI interactions, and inserting new contact data into the contacts provider.

classes.name: ContactAdder.AccountData
classes.description: Internal class representing account information including name, type, label, and icon.

classes.name: ContactAdder.AccountAdapter
classes.description: Custom ArrayAdapter to display account icons and descriptions in the Spinner.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method that initializes UI components, adapters, and account manager callback, and sets up UI event listeners.

methods.name: onSaveButtonClicked
methods.description: Handles the Save button click to create a new contact and finish the activity.

methods.name: createContactEntry
methods.description: Gathers user input and constructs batch operations to insert a new contact into the contacts provider.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Removes account update listener when activity is destroyed.

methods.name: onAccountsUpdated
methods.description: Updates the internal list of accounts whenever system accounts change.

methods.name: getAuthenticatorDescription
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve the AuthenticatorDescription for a given account type.

methods.name: updateAccountSelection
methods.description: Updates the selected account based on the current spinner selection.
